summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo (not run; verified by reading only, per instructions). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs; UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one Text with click spans added last; Opacity merges blended color via style + blended to preserve metadata; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; tests added to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and new tests/test_tabs.py. Choices: bar position uses displayed-tab indexes so duplicate names place the underline correctly; the layout resolver was left unchanged because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size, and fraction; Opacity has no dedicated test. Known limitations: a zero-width label is treated as flexible by the resolver, and the rich meta-merge behavior is unverified. Nothing was committed. Next step: run pytest on tests/renderables and tests/test_tabs.py, then the full suite.
